arguments.title: Northstar Observatory
arguments.brief: Responsive internal single-site night-operations console for an astronomy crew. Shared navigation: Night, Targets, Timeline, Systems, Handoff. Keep current night state and UTC/local toggle visible on every route; record desktop and narrow-screen intent in route content.

diagnostics.message: Surface draft has no entry route. The first addRoute call sets entry.
Surface draft must declare at least one route before export.

Telescope: tracking M42 / healthy. Current target: M42 Orion Nebula, exposure 3 of 8. Next events: 22:30 slew to NGC 2024; 23:10 autofocus. Include populated status cards, loading weather example, and empty next-event example.

Include empty filtered-results and loading queue examples; select M42 opens target detail.

DESKTOP two columns / NARROW single column. Persistent shared nav, ACTIVE night state, UTC/local toggle. Breadcrumb: Targets > M42; visible Back to target queue. M42 Orion Nebula. Coordinates RA 05h35m17s, Dec -05d23m28s. Finder preview placeholder. Visibility: rises 19:22, transit 00:41, sets 05:56; altitude now 47 degrees. Exposure sequence: 8 x 360s L, 6 x 300s R/G/B. Notes: check wind before next slew. Actions: Queue next, Skip tonight, Mark observed. Include warning wind conflict, loading finder preview, and empty notes state.

DESKTOP timeline / NARROW chronological cards. Persistent shared nav, ACTIVE night state, UTC/local toggle. Group the plan into Completed: polar alignment 20:05, calibration frames 20:40. Current: M42 exposure sequence, 22:14. Upcoming: NGC 2024 slew 22:30; M31 sequence 00:20. Delayed: guider calibration, planned 21:55, delayed to 22:45 because of wind. Include loading timeline and empty upcoming-work examples.

DESKTOP system grid / NARROW stacked status cards. Persistent shared nav, ACTIVE night state, UTC/local toggle. Telescope: HEALTHY, tracking; Dome: WARNING, wind threshold approaching; Camera: HEALTHY, -15 C; Guider: OFFLINE, no lock; Weather station: WARNING, gust sensor intermittent. Show healthy, warning, and offline legend. Troubleshooting panel: guider reset steps, dome wind interlock, weather-station last reading. Include loading telemetry and empty diagnostics examples.

DESKTOP three summary columns / NARROW stacked sections. Persistent shared nav, ACTIVE night state, UTC/local toggle. Completed observations: M42 partial L sequence, calibration frames. Unresolved alerts: critical wind threshold, guider offline, intermittent gust sensor. Next-shift priorities: diagnose guider, resume M42 if wind clears, execute NGC 2024. Primary action: Download handoff. Include populated report, loading export, and empty completed-observations examples.
